contributions.content: Produce a leadership-ready synthesis for this completed post-incident review. Requirements: (1) select and restate exactly 3 key insights grounded in the session's stored key_insights, (2) list the stored consensus_points as action items, (3) propose one concrete experiment to validate upstream connection pool exhaustion as the driver of 502s (include success metric and how to run at peak load), (4) answer the open question about whether to use separate pools per critical upstream (recommendation + rationale + tradeoffs). Keep it concise and actionable.

keyInsights: Most 502s correlated with upstream connection pool exhaustion, not app errors
Retry storms amplified load; client-side exponential backoff reduced error rate
Synthetic checks missed the issue due to low concurrency profiles
consensusPoints: Increase gateway upstream keepalive + tune max_conns per upstream
Add peak-load canary + high-concurrency synthetic monitors
Adopt standard client retry policy with jitter
openQuestions: Do we need separate pools per critical upstream to prevent noisy-neighbor effects?
args.finalRecommendation: Tune upstream pools and implement jittered retries; add peak-load monitoring and a canary gate before promotions.
